paper_id: TFormer_ A Transmission-Friendly ViT Model for IoT Devices
title: TFormer: A Transmission-Friendly ViT Model for IoT Devices
motivation: IoT设备资源受限且ViT参数量大,云端传输模型造成网络负载沉重
problem_framing: 需同时减少ViT模型的参数量和FLOPs以适配IoT设备部署
key_insight: MHA的本质等效于用多种滤波器提取不同特征,可用廉价池化替代
method_signature: 混合层(非可学池化+点卷积)+PCS-FFN(组卷积+通道混排)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 自适应注意力机制对高分辨率图像效率提升仍不足
evidence_for_taste: reducing r results in a significant degradation
PCS-FFN leads to a substantially better efficiency-performance tradeoff
Both adding more types of operations and adding more scales are beneficial
thinking_moves: 把MHA的本质重新解释为多滤波器特征提取,用廉价操作替代
从参数和FLOPs两个维度建立复杂度方程进行量化分析
通过消融实验验证多类型多尺度特征组合的有效性
将FFN问题归约为通道连接方式,用组卷积+混排解决
cites_own_work: Towards transmission-friendly and robust CNN models
Cognitive service in mobile edge computing
